title: Mirror, Mirror, Who Is the Loveliest "Me"?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
That person just now was my beloved
"Onee-chan"!
Though when I say that,
she's not actually my real sister...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
She was a trainer at the youth club I used
to attend.
She's incredibly smart, amazing at her job,
and so very kind!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the way North Flight speaks,
it's clear how much she adores her.
A person she can pamper herself around like
a real younger sister.
choice_data_list: She sounds like a wonderful person.
She sounds like a wonderful person...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Onee-chan is...
the "precious person" who recognized my raw
potential.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
As you already know,
I've got a frail body.
It's just my constitution.
Ever since I was little, always...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I had confidence in my speed.
People around me even
praised me,
saying I'd become an incredible horsegirl
once my body grew stronger!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
So naturally,
I became interested in racing and joined a
youth club.
At first, I was far ahead of everyone else,
you know? But...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The other girls grew up and got stronger
and stronger.
...While I, no matter how much time passed,
still couldn't run at full power.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
All that speed...
such wonderful raw material,
yet if I stayed just "me," it would never
shine.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
But I was lucky. —I met Onee-chan!
Her incredibly sophisticated poise,
the boundless warmth overflowing in every
word...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I fell in love with her at first sight!
Onee-chan taught me so much knowledge...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
About my body, conditioning,
racing... She taught me that if you find
the styling that suits you best,
any raw material can be made to shine.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's just like fashion,
right? So I thought long and hard...
and decided on the styling that would make
my raw material shine the brightest.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—I want to drape myself in an uncharted
brilliance no one else has ever reached.
Namely, claiming victory in sprints, miles,
and medium distances...
a "Three-Division Conquest."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Of course,
I understand how difficult that is with this
body.
Running with Bakushin O-chan made me realize
that all the more.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Unless you can give it your all,
you aren't even allowed to slip your arms
through the sleeves.
It's a demanding ensemble. But—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Without giving up, by thinking hard...
and continuously adorning myself with
knowledge. If I do that,
even this body will surely shine to its
absolute fullest!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Just like the other girls and Bakushin
O-chan,
I'll be able to pour out everything I have
and run with all my might.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I truly believe... that someday,
I can make the "me" I was born as shine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I am at a loss for words.
It's uncertain if she can even debut,
and even if she did,
there's no telling if she could endure
grueling races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so,
she keeps her eyes firmly fixed forward.
Loving who she is,
believing in her dazzling potential—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her brilliance is so dazzling,
it makes me squint.
With her intellect and unwavering
resolve...
she would surely achieve her wildest dreams,
even if she had to walk that path all
alone.
choice_data_list: (...I really was drawn to her, but...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her running had captured my heart completely.
But the trainer best suited for her...
the one who could truly make her shine—
surely that isn't someone like me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It was a few weeks later when I realized
just how fatal of a mistake that was...
the moment I heard that North Flight had
collapsed.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: —Huh, Trainer...? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, me? Yes, I'm perfectly fine.
I just got a little lightheaded,
that's all.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I was trying to test the upper limits of
the speed I can manage right now...
but it seems I pushed myself a bit too
hard.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I was trying to be careful,
but running makes it tricky.
After all,
deliberately holding back goes against
everything running stands for.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Conquering three different distances!
...I guess I'm in no position to talk about
that right now, huh?
Though of course,
I have zero intention of giving up!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
So, sorry for worrying you!
I'm all good now. —

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight flashed a cheerful smile.
She didn't seem weighed down by pressure in
the slightest.
She would probably just monitor her physical
condition even more carefully next time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a single notebook. On the cover,
written in neat, delicate handwriting,
were the words:
"Fu-chan's Race Research." The volume number
was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps due to the impact of the fall,
numerous clipped notes were scattered all
around. As I gathered them up...
glimpses of her everyday life inevitably
caught my eye—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hypothesis, practice, failure. Hypothesis,
practice, failure. Hypothesis, practice,
failure—
Spelled out across the pages was a relentless,
meticulous chronicle of facing her own body
day in and day out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even through plateaus,
her handwriting remained almost mechanically
precise. Which is why...
every single written word felt like a silent
scream tearing from her chest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I will never, ever give up.
As if I'd ever throw in the towel.
It's okay,
I can do this. I will shine. It's okay,
one day, without fail—"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "—I want to run at full throttle...!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—How could I have ever thought North Flight
was fine?
Sure, she's clever,
and her willpower is extraordinary.
But before any of that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course she wants to run with everything
she's got.
She wants to unleash all her glittering
talent,
every bit of potential she possesses—
without holding back,
without having to care about limits.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To hold all that inside,
running while forcing herself to believe
it'll all come true someday...
I can't even begin to imagine how painful
that must be.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With no track record to speak of,
there was zero basis to believe I could make
a difference. Still...
mourning my own "material" won't change a
thing.
I just have to think that much harder—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's when I remembered...
the "Big Sister" North Flight relies on so
much.
Before I knew it,
I had reached for my phone—
